title: Boolean parity modulation
statement: For a subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, define a bijection on functions $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ by sending $f$ to the function $x\mapsto f(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i$.
